title: F18 · Receding sparse crown / Slender curved hook / Heavy level bars

request.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: F86, full-body Guarin face study.
Image 1 is the exact F18 base: keep its jaw and cheek silhouette, mouth, same huge head and tiny squat body, S13 costume, mail, ragged red scarf and cape, boots, sword, shield, pose, elevated game camera, charcoal background, dull brown/gray/burgundy palette, and coarse flat granular 2D drawing.
Image 2 is the full original F37 drawing: use only its two eye marks and their scale/placement, not its brows, hair, nose, mouth or jaw. Image 3 is the exact F37 eye-only crop, showing the same fixed marks. The full image is included so the tiny crop cannot be ignored or read as an anatomical eyelid. Do not retain the eyes from Image 1.
FIXED EYES — literal graphic copy, not another style: Copy the two small flat dark ink marks from the original F37 reference. The near mark is an irregular little T: a short horizontal bar with a tiny central downward tick. The far mark is a smaller horizontal bar with a shorter downward tick. No eye anatomy, eyeballs, white wedges, sockets, squint creases, round dots, detached squares or highlights. Keep these marks completely independent of the eyebrow treatment.
At the original 1312 × 1199 frame, near eye is approximately 37 × 13 pixels, at x711–748 and y428–441. Far eye ink is approximately 24 × 10 pixels, at x807–831 and y429–440. Center spacing approximately 89 pixels. Match those small proportions exactly; do not enlarge or rotate them with the brows. Replace any pre-existing eye anatomy in the target. Preserve these two ink marks even as everything else listed below changes.
Change ONLY these three features:
HAIR: Receding sparse crown. High temples with sparse short dark wisps and a visible crown; same adult identity, not an elderly redesign.
NOSE: Long slender curved hook. About 16–22 pixels wide and 45–55 pixels tall at the original 1312-pixel canvas width. A very narrow bowed bridge, mild hump and rounded downward-hook tip. An unmistakably curved profile, not a straight rectangular column. The nose contour may move locally; preserve the rest of the head and jaw.
EYEBROWS: Heavy level bars: coarse thick nearly level eyebrows, separate from the eyes. Eyebrows ARE allowed to change. Do not change the eye shapes or squint them to follow the brows.
Keep the same art style and outfit. Flat worn rough pigment, dark, muddy, tired and wretched but exaggerated and cartoony. No 3D rendering, smooth skin, clean comic-book finish, portrait crop, extra objects, text, labels or contact sheet. One complete character in the same full-body frame.

parent_visual_review: Inspected original full-body output, final head/eye contact sheets and selected F37 eye reference. Receding sparse crown; Slender curved hook; Heavy level bars. The small flat ink bars with downward ticks retain the selected eye grammar; no square-dot or white-eye exploration. Source costume, giant head, squat body, elevated camera and granular drawing remain consistent. Generative repaint changes some eye edges and placement; these are visually matched studies, not pixel-identical copies. Some nose and brow differences need face zoom. Human selection remains pending.
